note: Rejudged 2026-10-28 after BlastRADIUS. rfc/full/rfc2865.txt Section 4.2: 'The Response Authenticator field MUST contain the correct response for the pending Access-Request.  Invalid packets are silently discarded.' buildResponse now signs every non-accounting answer (buildReplyResponse), so TestClientAuthenticatorVerify's first reply, built with 'wrong-key', carries a wrong Message-Authenticator HMAC as well as a wrong Response Authenticator. client.go dispatchResponse verifies the Response Authenticator, then verifyResponseMessageAuthenticator (RFC 2869 5.14) discards a bad HMAC. A client that stopped verifying the Response Authenticator (VerifyResponseAuth returning true) would still drop that reply on the HMAC, retransmit, and keep attempts >= 2: the negative stays green under the exact non-compliance it names (question 3, isolation lost). The recorded revert (VerifyResponseAuth body replaced by a panic) cannot show this because a panic reddens either way. Fix: the first reply must carry a correct Message-Authenticator and only a wrong Response Authenticator (sign with the right key, then corrupt the RA), so only VerifyResponseAuth can reject it. Positive half (correctly signed reply accepted) still holds.
